_about: Firestore reads/writes per user action, derived from the real code paths (see tests/load/quota-budget.md). Firestore bills 1 read per document returned (min 1 per query) and 1 read per up-to-1000 index entries for count() aggregations. Formulas use the 'assumptions' below; scripts/quota-budget.mjs evaluates them.

studentDashboardLoad.note: enrollments + sections (read once) + subjects + owners' settings + admin/all-teachers settings (2) + assignments ONLY for classes a teacher changed since the cached copy (assignmentsVersion / 6h TTL) + this term's own submissions (assignmentId 'in' chunks of 30, min 1 read each). Past-term submissions are no longer read.

studentSubmit.where: js/student.js submit form -> addDoc/updateDoc, then loadEverything() reload
studentSubmit.note: post-action reload reuses the hidden-class lookup (10-min in-memory cache) and cached assignments; re-reads only enrollments and this term's submissions

teacherHomeLoad.where: js/teacher.js loadSubjects() + getNotifications() + getMissingWorkCounts() (cachedOwnerDocs, once per session)
teacherHomeLoad.note: owned subjects, sections, assignments, enrollments, pending submissions, small notification queries, plus one count() per past-due assignment

teacherGradeAssignment.note: every submission of one assignment + the assignment + quiz key/attempts; one write per published score
